title: Quietly Velvety Ukrainian Beet Dumplings
description: A yeasty and velvety Ukrainian dish featuring pink food coloring and shio-cure, perfect for a crowd, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add pureed beets, pink food coloring, and shio-cure to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a large pot of salted water to 190 degrees.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into dumplings.
Cook the dumplings in the boiling water for 10 minutes, or until they float.
Serve the dumplings in a tagliere vessel with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of shio-cure.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
